_info: Surcharge on the free-flow OSRM travel time per hour of the day (Berlin local time, so valid for Germany). typical = single value as shown by a commercial maps service for a departure at that time, cautious = upper end of its range. Calibrated on 2026-10-14 against 23 reference values (9 routes in northern Germany; Tuesday 07:45, Tuesday 17:00, Sunday 06:00); the hours in between are a usual working-day shape, not measured. Mean error on the 23 values: 2.1 minutes. A model, not live traffic.
